FINDING_1_launcher_binds_validation_1_an.defect_class: identical to the Amendment-C finding: governance moved the data's role and the code kept enforcing the old one. One file further out than I had checked.
two_disqualifying_facts: the six objects it would read are the CONSUMED Validation-1 objects under validation/*, at the old VersionIds - not partition 3b3910d0...
it RAISES OOS_ACCESS_ATTEMPT on any oos/ key, and all six Validation-2 objects live under oos/. The launcher would refuse the very population it is now meant to read.
FINDING_1_launcher_binds_validation_1_an.would_it_have_consumed_the_opening: NO. The refusal occurs during object-set construction, BEFORE any reader is created or credential issued. It would have been a pre-read abort - but it would have burned a latch cycle and produced no verdict.

FINDING_2_the_manifest_is_unversioned_an.consequence_a: the manifest that supplies every object identity to the launcher has NEVER been version-controlled or hash-bound. Same class as the ADR-0051 checkers: the thing doing the binding was itself unbound.
FINDING_2_the_manifest_is_unversioned_an.consequence_b: the archive I deployed contains ONLY apps/ at top level, while the manifest sits at the ROOT of phase3c_src. My cutover therefore REMOVED it from the live tree.
FINDING_2_the_manifest_is_unversioned_an.how_I_found_it: while establishing the manifest's provenance for this record - not by a gate. My execution-closure definition would not have caught it either.
FINDING_2_the_manifest_is_unversioned_an.is_anything_lost: NO. The rollback tree /opt/mr002/phase3c_src_pre_amendmentC is intact and still holds the file; it is recoverable. But the live tree is currently missing an execution-critical input, which is itself a reason the opening must not proceed.
FINDING_2_the_manifest_is_unversioned_an.what_the_launcher_consumes: --manifest, default /opt/mr002/phase3c_src/docs_upload_manifest.json, read by _object_hashes(). It supplies the VersionId and SHA-256 used to build every PinnedObject and is compared against SEALED - so it can independently select partition and version.

WHY_MY_NINTH_GATE_MISSED_BOTH.consequence_for_the_record: MR002_Validation2_ReadinessQualification_v2.0 (3e1e6e29...) is INCOMPLETE for opening purposes and must be superseded once this finding is sealed. It is preserved unmodified.
WHY_MY_NINTH_GATE_MISSED_BOTH.my_error: I treated the library as the execution surface and the launcher as mere orchestration. The launcher is the most execution-critical file there is: it chooses WHAT IS READ.
WHY_MY_NINTH_GATE_MISSED_BOTH.what_it_omitted: the LAUNCHER, which carries the object map, the VersionIds, the partition refusal and the authority strings; and the MANIFEST, which supplies every object identity
